evals.prompt: Build me a small web app for tracking freelance invoices. I want to add clients, enter invoice amount/status, and see totals for paid vs unpaid. Use whatever frontend stack makes sense and give me a preview link.
evals.expected_output: Creates a working web app project with sensible stack selection, invoice/client UI, stateful interactions or local storage, build verification, and a live preview link.

evals.prompt: I already have a Vite React app in /agent/acme-dashboard. Add a responsive analytics dashboard page with cards, a filter, and a table. Don't rewrite the whole app.
evals.expected_output: Inspects existing project, preserves structure, adds dashboard components/styles, runs relevant verification, and summarizes changed files.

evals.prompt: 做一个简单的网页应用：番茄钟 + 待办事项，能开始/暂停计时，任务可以勾选完成。要能在浏览器里打开。
evals.expected_output: Builds a browser-previewable pomodoro/todo app, likely static or Vite depending on complexity, with start/pause timer and task completion interactions.
